source.title: [$175] Inline editing an expense description strips line breaks and Markdown

source.body:
Editing an expense description inline on desktop flattens it to plain text. Saving even a small edit overwrites the original line breaks and Markdown. This is follow-up #3 from #82534, tracked separately as [discussed here](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/82534#issuecomment-7121790915). The line-break issue was also reported in #88651 and deferred to a follow-up. ## Action Performed 1. On desktop, create an expense and set its description from the expense details page: ```text Client dinner with *Acme Corp* Attendees: John, Sarah ``` 2. Open the expense table in the report or Search and click the **Description** cell to edit it inline. 3. Add `!` at the end and press Enter to save. 4. Reopen the expense details. ## Expected Result The description keeps its line break and **Acme Corp** stays bold. Only the `!` is added. ## Actual Result The editor shows one line of plain text. The saved description is `Client dinner with Acme Corp Attendees: John, Sarah!`, without the line break or bold formatting. ## Workaround Edit the description from the expense details page instead of the table cell.

comments.author: MelvinBot
comments.text:
## Proposal

### What is the root cause of that problem?

The inline editor uses the **display-only, flattened description as its editable value**. Stored formatting is removed and line breaks become spaces before editing begins. Adding `!` then saves that entire flattened value, replacing the original description.

There is also an input configuration gap: descriptions are treated as multiline in the change handler, but the actual input is not configured as multiline.

**Confidence: Medium** — both table paths and the save pipeline were traced in code; browser reproduction was not performed.

<details>
<summary>Code evidence</summary>

- **Formatting is lost before editing:** [`MerchantCell.tsx:34–55`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L34-L55) applies `htmlToText` and `lineBreaksToSpaces`, then passes the result into `useInlineEditState`. Its description change handler already preserves incoming text; the merchant-only sanitizer is not the cause.
- **The input remains single-line:** [`MerchantCell.tsx:87–109`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L87-L109) supplies neither multiline nor auto-growing configuration.
- **A small edit commits the whole damaged value:** [`useInlineEditState.ts:59–77`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/components/EditableCell/useInlineEditState.ts#L59-L77) calls `onSave(localValue)` when it differs from the initial value. Opening and leaving unchanged should not save.
- **Saving cannot recover deleted formatting:** [`UpdateMoneyRequest.ts:1603–1652`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/libs/actions/IOU/UpdateMoneyRequest.ts#L1603-L1652) parses that replacement and sends it as the updated description.
- Both [Search](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/components/Search/SearchList/ListItem/TransactionListItem/TransactionListItemWide.tsx#L204-L249) and [report tables](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/components/MoneyRequestReportView/MoneyRequestReportTransactionItem.tsx#L339-L376) use the shared transaction-row editing implementation.

</details>

### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?

Separate the table preview from the editable description:

1. Keep the existing single-line, plain-text preview.
2. Initialize description editing with **HTML converted back to Markdown**, matching the full description page—not raw stored HTML.
3. Configure descriptions as multiline inputs, preferably using the existing Markdown input. Preserve Enter-to-save, blur-to-save, Escape cancellation, and merchant-specific behavior.
4. Add regression coverage for formatted multiline descriptions, appending `!`, unchanged blur, cancellation, multiline paste, and unchanged merchant behavior. Verify both Search and report tables on web.

<details>
<summary>Reference implementation and validation</summary>

The full description page already [converts stored HTML to editable Markdown](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/pages/iou/request/step/DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx#L93-L102) and [uses an auto-growing Markdown input](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/513ac35feca31b54c86cb8866d304c4339e34b5a/src/pages/iou/request/step/DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx#L230-L245).

Browser verification should specifically check that enabling multiline preserves existing line breaks while plain Enter still saves.

</details>

### What alternative solutions did you explore?

- **Use raw stored HTML:** Incorrect—the editable representation should be Markdown, as in the full editor.
- **Change only the initial value:** Incomplete—the input must also support multiline content, and the preview must remain separate.
- **Investigate response ordering:** This cannot explain formatting already missing before save.

**Related issues:** [Expense description reverts after saving](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/101937) concerns stale values after saving; [Rules Markdown is not saved](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/108045) concerns a separate rule-writing path. Neither is established as a duplicate.

---
**Next Steps for Contributor+ team:**
**To accept:** `@MelvinBot implement [this](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/108117)` to create a draft PR.
**To refine:** `@MelvinBot <your feedback>`
**To reject:** Explain why you are rejecting Melvin's proposal.


---

comments.author: elghaffaryoussef1-dotcom
comments.text:
## Proposal ### Please re-state the problem that we are trying to solve in this issue. When inline-editing an expense **Description** cell in desktop tables (both Report and Search tables), the cell strips Markdown formatting and flattens line breaks into spaces as soon as editing starts. Making any edit and saving overwrites the stored HTML description with that flattened plain text. ### What is the root cause of that problem? In [`src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/main/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx), `MerchantOrDescriptionCell` conflates the single-line plain-text display value with the editable description value and leaves the underlying `TextInput` single-line: 1. **Display-only plain text is fed into `useInlineEditState` (`MerchantCell.tsx:34-44`)**: ```tsx const text = !isDescription ? merchantOrDescription : StringUtils.lineBreaksToSpaces(Parser.htmlToText(merchantOrDescription)); ``` `text` strips HTML formatting via `Parser.htmlToText` and collapses newlines via `StringUtils.lineBreaksToSpaces`, then passes that flattened string as the initial edit buffer to `useInlineEditState`. In contrast, the full description editor (`src/pages/iou/request/step/DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx:95-97`) converts stored HTML into editable Markdown via `Parser.htmlToMarkdown(...)`. 2. **Single-line `TextInput` strips newlines even though `isMultilineInput` is declared (`MerchantCell.tsx:46, 87-103`)**: `const isMultilineInput = isDescription;` is only checked in `handleChangeText` (lines 48-55) and is never forwarded to ``. Without `multiline` / `autoGrowHeight` / `type="markdown"`, React Native Web renders a single-line ``, which strips ` ` immediately. 3. **Display rendering currently binds to `localValue` (`MerchantCell.tsx:106-112`)**: `` renders `localValue` directly when not editing. Once `useInlineEditState` buffers Markdown for descriptions, binding `TextWithTooltip` to `localValue` would leak raw Markdown syntax (e.g., `*Acme Corp*`) and raw newlines into the collapsed table cell. 4. **Inline-cell input styles conflict with auto-growing Markdown height (`src/styles/index.ts:1565-1574` & `src/components/TextInput/BaseTextInput/implementation/index.tsx:370-372, 417-428`)**: `styles.editableCellInputStyle` sets `height: '100%'` on both `textInputContainerStyles` and `touchableInputWrapperStyle`. Inside `BaseTextInput`, `isAutoGrowHeightMarkdown` also applies `{minHeight: variables.componentSizeLarge}` and `pb2`/`pb1` padding. Passing `autoGrowHeight` + `type="markdown"` without a multiline-safe cell override causes fixed-height clipping or vertical row jumps on single-line descriptions. ### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem? 1. **Decouple display preview from the editable Markdown buffer in `src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx`**: - Keep the collapsed single-line plain-text preview separate: ```tsx const displayText = !isDescription ? merchantOrDescription : StringUtils.lineBreaksToSpaces(Parser.htmlToText(merchantOrDescription)); const editableValue = !isDescription ? merchantOrDescription : Parser.htmlToMarkdown(merchantOrDescription); ``` - Pass `editableValue` into `useInlineEditState(...)` so opening inline edit loads Markdown with preserved line breaks (`Client dinner with *Acme Corp* Attendees: John, Sarah`), matching `DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx:95-97` and satisfying `containsHtmlTag` validation in `src/libs/actions/TransactionInlineEdit.ts:329-332` (`editTransactionDescriptionInline`). - Pass `text={isDescription ? displayText : localValue}` to `` so both wide table cells (`TransactionItemRowWide.tsx:461`) and narrow titles (`TransactionItemRowNarrowTitle.tsx:36`) continue rendering clean single-line plain text when not editing (and refresh immediately via optimistic Onyx writes from `updateMoneyRequestDescription`). - Align description normalization in `getNormalizedValue` with `editTransactionDescriptionInline` (`StringUtils.removeInvisibleCharacters(value)` for descriptions, which retains internal ` ` via `.split(' ')...join(' ').trim()`, keeping `value.trim()` for merchants) so opening and blurring without real edits or adding only trailing invisible characters does not trigger redundant `UPDATE_MONEY_REQUEST_DESCRIPTION` calls. 2. **Enable auto-growing Markdown multiline editing for descriptions in `MerchantCell.tsx` while keeping `Enter` to save and `Shift+Enter` for newlines**: - When `isDescription` is true, pass `type="markdown"`, `multiline`, `autoGrowHeight`, and `maxAutoGrowHeight={variables.textInputAutoGrowMaxHeight}` to `` (leaving merchant editing unchanged as single-line). - Add an `onKeyPress` handler for `isDescription` on web (following `SearchNLFilterContent.tsx:125-136`, guarded with `isEnterWhileComposition`): - Plain `Enter` (without `shiftKey` and not composing): `e.preventDefault(); save();` so pressing `Enter` saves without inserting an unwanted trailing newline. - `Shift+Enter`: allowed through so users can insert new lines inline. - `Escape`: continues calling `handleEscape` via `useKeyboardShortcut`, resetting to `editableValue` without saving. - Add a multiline-safe style adjustment (e.g., `height: 'auto'` and compact `minHeight` matching `editableCellHeight` / `0` instead of `height: '100%'` and `componentSizeLarge`) for the description inline editor so single-line descriptions keep compact row height while multi-line descriptions expand cleanly up to `maxAutoGrowHeight` and scroll internally, preserving `handleFocus` (`scrollToBottom` + `moveSelectionToEnd`). 3. **Add unit/component regression tests**: - Cover `MerchantOrDescriptionCell` with `isDescription` for: - Stored HTML with Markdown + `
` (e.g., `Client dinner with Acme Corp
Attendees: John, Sarah`): collapsed `TextWithTooltip` shows plain single-line text, entering edit mode populates Markdown with ` `, appending `!` and pressing `Enter` calls `onSave` with Markdown + ` ` intact. - `Shift+Enter` inserts a newline without saving; IME composition `Enter` does not prematurely save. - Blur without edits does not call `onSave`; `Escape` cancels and restores `editableValue`. - Merchant cell (`isDescription={false}`) keeps single-line sanitization (`lineBreaksToSpaces`) and trimming unchanged. - Verify end-to-end in both Report and Search tables on desktop web. ### What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional) - **Initializing the editor with raw stored HTML (`merchantOrDescription`)**: Rejected — users would see raw tags like `` / `
`, and `editTransactionDescriptionInline` (`src/libs/actions/TransactionInlineEdit.ts:330`) explicitly rejects HTML tags with `common.error.invalidCharacter`. - **Using `autoGrowSingleLine` on `BaseTextInput`**: Rejected — `BaseTextInput`'s `autoGrowSingleLine` intercepts `Shift+Enter` to submit (`src/components/TextInput/BaseTextInput/index.tsx:22-32`), which would prevent inserting line breaks in multiline descriptions. - **Plain multiline `TextInput` without `type="markdown"`**: Works for preserving Markdown characters as raw text, but `type="markdown"` matches `DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx:244` so users get live Markdown formatting and consistent `HtmlPasteHandler` paste behavior when editing descriptions inline.

comments.author: mattlsyyssll
comments.text:
## Proposal ### What is the root cause of that problem? There are three causes in [`MerchantCell.tsx`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx), the cell used for the Description column. 1. **The editor starts from the display text.** [L34](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L34) turns the stored HTML into plain text and turns line breaks into spaces. That one value is passed to `useInlineEditState` ([L39-44](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L39-L44)). It becomes `localValue`, which is both the editor value ([L90](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L90)) and the preview text ([L106-112](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L106-L112)). The hook also resets `localValue` to this same value ([L35-38](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/EditableCell/useInlineEditState.ts#L35-L38), [L46-51](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/EditableCell/useInlineEditState.ts#L46-L51)). Any edit then sends the flattened text through [`editTransactionDescriptionInline`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/libs/actions/TransactionInlineEdit.ts#L325-L346) to [`updateMoneyRequestDescription`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/libs/actions/IOU/UpdateMoneyRequest.ts#L1603), which parses it as Markdown. The `*` marks and line breaks are already gone, so the saved HTML is one plain line. The description page does it right: it edits [`Parser.htmlToMarkdown(...)`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/pages/iou/request/step/DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx#L93-L102) in a [Markdown input that grows](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/pages/iou/request/step/DynamicIOURequestStepDescription.tsx#L234-L245). 2. **The input is single-line.** [L46](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L46) sets `isMultilineInput` for descriptions, but it is only used in `handleChangeText`. The `TextInput` ([L87-103](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L87-L103)) gets no `multiline`, `autoGrowHeight` or `type="markdown"`, so on web it renders a single-line `` ([BaseTextInput L348](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TextInput/BaseTextInput/implementation/index.tsx#L348), [L563](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TextInput/BaseTextInput/implementation/index.tsx#L563)). The browser drops line breaks from a single-line input by itself. So fixing only cause 1 would still lose line breaks. 3. **The cell style blocks a taller input.** The cell passes [`editableCellInputStyle`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/styles/index.ts#L1565-L1574) ([L99-100](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx#L99-L100)), which sets `height: '100%'`. That pins the input to the row height, so a multi-line description cannot be shown even if the input were multi-line. ### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem? All changes are in `MerchantCell.tsx`, for descriptions only. Merchant stays as it is. 1. **Split the preview from the edit value.** - Edit value (passed to `useInlineEditState`): `Parser.htmlToMarkdown(description)`, the same as the description page. - Preview: compute `lineBreaksToSpaces(htmlToText(description))` from the prop and pass it to `TextWithTooltip`, instead of `localValue`. If we only change the edit value, the one-line preview would show raw Markdown like `*Acme Corp*`. - Since the hook compares the new value with the edit value, opening and leaving without a change still does not save. 2. **Make the input a growing Markdown input.** Add `multiline`, `autoGrowHeight`, a `maxAutoGrowHeight` and `type="markdown"` to the description `TextInput`. Keep `submitBehavior="blurAndSubmit"`, `onSubmitEditing={save}` and `onBlur={save}`. With the existing react-native-web `submitBehavior` patch, plain Enter saves and Shift+Enter adds a new line. Do **not** use `autoGrowSingleLine`: it makes Shift+Enter save too ([BaseTextInput L20-37](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/c0604399d893869f81bf3bf222be9f0222ffca60/src/components/TextInput/BaseTextInput/index.tsx#L20-L37)), so a user could never add a line. 3. **Let the description input grow.** For descriptions, override `height: '100%'` with `height: 'auto'` and a max height that scrolls inside the input. A one-line description then looks like today's input, and a multi-line one gets a taller box. This matches the design direction in #83127 ("wrapped ones to be taller inputs and the ones that don't have a regular input"). The existing `handleFocus` already moves the cursor to the end and scrolls to the bottom, so long values open at the end. 4. **Tests** (`MerchantCell` / inline edit tests): - Stored `Client dinner with Acme Corp
Attendees: John, Sarah`: the editor shows `Client dinner with *Acme Corp*\nAttendees: John, Sarah`, and adding `!` saves `...*Acme Corp*\nAttendees: John, Sarah!`. - The preview stays one line of plain text. - Open and blur without a change does not save. Escape cancels. - Merchant cell stays single-line and still turns pasted line breaks into spaces. Pseudo-code: ``` preview = isDescription ? lineBreaksToSpaces(htmlToText(value)) : value editValue = isDescription ? htmlToMarkdown(value) : value useInlineEditState(canEdit, editValue, ...) TextInput: isDescription -> multiline, autoGrowHeight, maxAutoGrowHeight, type="markdown", height auto TextWithTooltip text = preview ``` ### What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional) - **Edit the stored HTML as is.** Rejected: users would see `` and `
` tags, and `editTransactionDescriptionInline` rejects HTML tags. - **Open the full description page from the cell when the description has several lines or Markdown.** Rejected: it works, but it drops inline editing for those expenses, which is the feature this follow-up is for.

comments.author: letiggo
comments.text:
Proposal
Please re-state the problem that we are trying to solve in this issue.
On desktop, inline-editing an expense description from the expense table (report table or Search) flattens it to plain text: saving even a tiny edit (e.g. adding !) overwrites the original description, losing its line breaks and Markdown formatting (e.g. _Acme Corp_ bold). Editing from the full expense details page does not lose formatting.
What is the root cause of that problem?
I verified the diagnosis against the code on main. The formatting is destroyed before editing even begins, in MerchantOrDescriptionCell (src/components/TransactionItemRow/DataCells/MerchantCell.tsx), which renders both the merchant and the description cells:
// MerchantCell.tsx:34 — the description's editable initial value
const text = !isDescription ? merchantOrDescription : StringUtils.lineBreaksToSpaces(Parser.htmlToText(merchantOrDescription));
Parser.htmlToText strips the Markdown formatting and lineBreaksToSpaces turns newlines into spaces, and this flattened string is passed as the initial value to useInlineEditState (lines 39-44). From then on the editor only knows the damaged value, so any save overwrites the original description with it.
There is a second, independent defect in the same file. The component already computes const isMultilineInput = isDescription; (line 46) and the change handler already preserves text for multiline inputs (lines 50-55) — but isMultilineInput is never passed to the <TextInput> (lines 87-109): no multiline prop and no auto-growing configuration. So the description editor is a single-line input even though descriptions are multiline content.
The save path then commits the damage: useInlineEditState (src/components/EditableCell/useInlineEditState.ts:59-77) calls onSave(localValue) whenever the value differs from the initial value, so appending ! saves the entire flattened string. Opening the editor and leaving it unchanged does not save (the isEqual check), which is why the bug only bites once you actually edit.
What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?
1.  In MerchantOrDescriptionCell, initialize description editing with Markdown, not flattened plain text: use Parser.htmlToMarkdown(merchantOrDescription) (available at src/libs/Parser.ts:38) as the initial value for descriptions — the same representation the full description page already uses for editing. Keep the existing single-line plain-text preview for display (TextWithTooltip with numberOfLines={1}).
2.  Pass multiline (with auto-growing height) to the <TextInput> when isDescription is true, so line breaks can be entered and displayed while editing. Preserve the existing behavior: Enter to save, blur to save, Escape to cancel, and the merchant-specific sanitization (line-break stripping and trimming) untouched for non-description cells.
3.  Add regression tests for formatted multiline descriptions: append ! to a _bold_ two-line description and verify the line break and bold survive; opening and blurring unchanged saves nothing; Escape cancels; multiline paste keeps line breaks; merchant editing behavior unchanged. Verify on both the report table and Search, on web.
What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional)
•  Using the raw stored HTML as the editable value: rejected — the editable representation should be Markdown, matching the full description page.
•  Changing only the initial value without making the input multiline: rejected — the input must also accept multiline content, otherwise newlines still cannot be entered or displayed while editing.
•  Fixing only the save side (e.g. merging the saved value with the original formatting): rejected — once the editor starts from a flattened value, the original formatting is unrecoverable at save time; the fix belongs at initialization.
QA steps (to verify the fix)
1.  On desktop web, create an expense with a two-line description containing bold Markdown (e.g. Client dinner with _Acme Corp_ + Attendees: John, Sarah).
2.  In the report expense table, click the Description cell, append !, press Enter, then reopen the expense details: the line break and bold formatting are preserved, only ! was added.

comments.text:
@MelvinBot implement [this](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/108117) with these design requirements from the v1 inline-edit PR (#83127):

**Design requirements**
1. A description that fits on one line opens in a regular one-line input, at the same height as the cell. It must not open at 2 lines or jump in height ([Shawn](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/83127#issuecomment-4064293056): "It should start off as just 1 line and only grow as you add enough text to make it grow to a second line").
2. A description that wraps or has several lines gets a taller input that grows as you type ([Jon](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/83127#issuecomment-4107065519): "we'd want the wrapped ones to be taller inputs and the ones that don't have a regular input").
3. The cursor is at the end of the text when the input opens ([Shawn](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/83127#issuecomment-4064285462)).
4. Line breaks and Markdown are kept: edit the description as Markdown (`Parser.htmlToMarkdown`), like the description page. While not editing, the table still shows one line of plain text.
